interpretation: Not a physical microphone, production-origin, or complete browser compatibility certification. Isolated Chromium ran the actual UI logic with named-module bundling, memory-only localStorage, bridged SHA-256, and an empty static catalog fetch test double. Real HTMLMediaElement Blob/WAV playback worked; no fake media clock was needed. Browser policies prevented normal URL navigation and getUserMedia, so production ES module/HTTP/CSP delivery, IndexedDB persistence, service-worker offline behavior, live capture, and physical dual-input synchronization remain unverified.
